Department for Environment, Food & Rural.text: Six rows on the sheet. The 3B pen-test call-off (£250k) is DEFR-ITPT in HubSpot Pipeline and is disregarded; the four ADMS Data & AI opportunities (£2.2m TCV, £440k weighted) are fronted by i-10 and were loaded under the i-10 account in HubSpot, so they appear on the i-10 card. The only Defra-coded plan deal is the £120k pen-test extension option starting April 2028. The plan therefore adds nothing to Defra’s FY27 directly; CASC remains the deal that matters.
Department for Environment, Food & Rural.watch: DEFR-CASC closing by 26 Feb 2027 for a 1 April start. The i-10 deals still carry a Defra association in HubSpot that should be removed.

British Library.text: Thirteen rows, of which Managed SOC (£200k) is BLIB-MSOC and Azure Engineering Managed Services (£400k) is BLIB-AMSS in HubSpot Pipeline, so both are disregarded. The remaining eleven are £4.4m TCV, £1.64m weighted, with differentiated probabilities: Power Platform remediation (£200k, 75%), P3M delivery partner (£750k, 50%, September), Cloud roadmap (£500k, 50%) and Azure workload migration (£350k, 50%); Network Modernisation (£750k) and Data Strategy (£450k) are the large 25% items. £1.97m falls in FY27 unweighted, £0.7m weighted, on top of TRSF/TRSG.
British Library.watch: The January starts (TOM, Data Strategy) need to be in HubSpot by November to be resourced.

Department for Education.text: Fourteen rows; the Infrastructure Services contract extension (£1.2m) is already in HubSpot Pipeline as DFE-INFF for FY28 and is disregarded. The thirteen that remain are £6.45m TCV, £2.08m weighted, but the one that matters is outside FY27: the Aggregated DevOps extension (£1.8m, 80%, July 2029, the contract allows extension). The twelve FY27 items are a Cloud and platform-engineering menu (single DevOps capability, DR, application modernisation factory, FinOps, cloud security) at 10–20% probability each, £1.84m in-year unweighted but only £0.23m weighted. The One Customer tenant consolidation (£750k) is logged for April 2028.
Department for Education.watch: Whether the 10% items firm up once BDEV is signed; until then the plan adds little to FY27.

National Crime Agency.text: Six opportunities, £4.65m TCV, but £3.0m of it is the DevOps and Support Service uplift for the April 2029 mobilisation (80%) — the contract runs to November 2028 plus two one-year options, already factored to March 2029 in HubSpot. The FY27 items are Platform Optimisation on AWS (£500k, 25%, April), Enterprise Data Platform and AI Operations (£450k each, from October) and a Claude model evaluation (£150k). Financial Crime Programme Delivery is already being worked under IFUB.
National Crime Agency.watch: AI Operations is "already in HubSpot to end September"; make sure the October extension is not double-counted against the HubSpot record.

Ministry of Justice.text: Seven rows, of which four are already HubSpot Pipeline records (AIGP, TCIP, MACR and the MFA discovery MFAM) and are disregarded. The three that remain — Discovery/Alpha to Beta/Live (£750k, 40%), Prisons Data and Operational AI (£250k, 40%) and Prison devices/data/AI implementation (£150k, 50%), all from April — are £1.15m TCV, £0.47m weighted, £0.9m in FY27. They describe the same work as the £0.8m IBAP Forecast Placeholder, so the two should not be counted together.
Ministry of Justice.watch: Replace MOJ-IBAP with the three named opportunities so the placeholder and the plan are not both counted.

i-10.text: Four ADMS Data & AI opportunities for Defra, fronted by i-10 and loaded in HubSpot under the i-10 account: Data Platform Optimisation / Managed Data (£750k) and AI Industrialisation / Operations (£750k) from April 2027, a Claude agentic delivery evaluation (£200k, June, Defra will not run evaluations beyond 12 weeks) and Claude Knowledge-Work Automation (£500k, October, dependent on the evaluation) — all at 20%, £2.2m TCV, £440k weighted. All depend on the success of the current DDDC project and Transform alignment.
i-10.watch: The ADMS items are sequenced: evaluation first, then automation. Treat the i-10 and Defra numbers together when reading the Defra account.

Department for Environment, Food & Rural.text: Four live rows, £6.8m TCV, almost all CASD — Capability as a Service year 3 (£6.0m, 75%, April 2028), which HubSpot now carries as DEFR-CASD in Commit. Business Change advisory (£250k) and GovAssure audit (£150k) are 2026 items.

Department for Work and Pensions.text: Twelve live rows, £12.6m TCV, dominated by the network services contract (£980k year one, £2.0m years two and three, £2.5m 50% uplift from October 2028, all at 75%), ISOP Extension (£2.0m, 80%, from March 2027) and Health Data FY27 (£1.4m, 50%, July 2027). The FY27 sheet replaced these with named Technology Services, Infrastructure and Data Platforms items at lower values.

British Library.text: Eight rows, £8.15m TCV: P3M delivery partner (£1.75m, 75%, October 2026), New Contract Headroom (£2.0m, 50%), Cloud roadmap (£1.65m, 50%), Restoration of Services phase 2 (£1.5m, 10%) and continued Azure engineering (£400k, 75%). The FY27 sheet keeps the same themes at shorter durations and lower values.

Ministry of Housing, Communities and Loc.text: Ten rows, £3.99m TCV: Common Data Platform next generation (£850k, 25%), AI Transformation (£1.0m, 10%), P3M delivery partner (£600k, 50%) and a set of 2026 extensions (TARC/TARE £280k, data platform £350k, cloud architecture £150k) that have since been won or lapsed.

National Crime Agency.text: Six rows, £11.6m TCV, all Managed Services: Azure Platforms DevOps Support (£4.0m, 60%, September 2026), Financial Crime Programme Delivery (£1.5m, 25%), the December 2029 DevOps uplift (£5.0m, 50%) and three smaller platform items. The FY27 sheet reduced the uplift to £3.0m at 80% from April 2029.

Department for Education.text: Seven rows, £13.8m TCV: Azure Cloud infrastructure engineering (£3.5m, 80%, October 2026), the DevOps contract extensions (£3.2m and £1.7m, 80%, July 2029), single DevOps and platform engineering (£2.25m, 50%) and One Customer tenant consolidation (£2.5m, 10%). The FY27 sheet carries the same extensions at £1.8m and £1.2m.

Ministry of Justice.text: One live row: MOJ Innovation Projects, £3.9m TCV at 75% from July 2026 — headroom on the existing contract. The FY27 sheet replaced it with seven named items worth £1.59m.

Competition and Markets Authority.text: CMA DDAT delivery headroom (£1.63m, 75%, December 2026) and a 25% contract uplift (£500k, February 2028). HubSpot carries CMA-DDAT as a £300k Forecast Placeholder, so the plan and the placeholder disagree on size.

Homes England.text: One row: Data Transformation, £750k at 75% from October 2026, re-budgeted down from £2.0m. No FY27 HubSpot deal.
